messages.en: Wow, you've finished decorating all this? It looks beautiful!
Thanks! I just did a little at a time after work.

messages.en: You look so tired in this photo. Didn't get enough sleep last night?
Yeah, I was up until three finishing some work. That's why I've got panda eyes 😂

messages.en: Let's grab something to eat downstairs during our break later. Want to come?
Yes! But I'll head down a bit later. I want to finish this work first.

Everyone except Sara. She said she's joining now.
